2027-01-08.resolve: Speak one hard truth this week, gently and with love.

intro: Theme: “The Father is in me and I am in the Father.”
Faith receives the Son whom the Father sent.

q: And he believed the LORD; and the LORD reckoned it to him as righteousness.
What then are we to say? Gentiles, who did not strive for righteousness, have attained it, that is, righteousness through faith;
points.apply: Thank God each night this week for one undeserved gift.

q: therefore thus says the Lord GOD, See, I am laying in Zion a foundation stone, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation: “One who trusts will not panic.”
as it is written, “See, I am laying in Zion a stone that will make people stumble, a rock that will make them fall, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame.”
points.apply: Bring one area of pride to Christ in confession.

q: I say, “You are gods, children of the Most High, all of you;
But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.
points.apply: Write down one work of God you have seen this year and thank him for it.

concl: The Son revealed at the Jordan is one with the Father.
Faith builds on him; pride stumbles over him.
2027-01-09.resolve: Make an act of faith in Jesus, true God and true man, each morning this week.

intro: Theme: “That they may all be one.”
Jesus' prayer for unity, and Paul's warning against division at the Lord's table.

sub: Contempt for the poor is contempt for the Church.
q: How very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
For, to begin with, when you come together as a church, I hear that there are divisions among you; and to some extent I believe it.
points.apply: Make peace with one person before your next Holy Qurbana.

points.h: That they may all be one
sub: The Father in the Son, the Son in the Father.
Unity is a gift before it is a task.
q: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king over them all. Never again shall they be two nations, and never again shall they be divided into two kingdoms.
that they may all be one. As you, Father, are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
points.apply: Pray daily for the unity of all Christians.

points.h: So that the world may believe
q: he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to restore the survivors of Israel; I will give you as a light to the nations, that my salvation may reach to the end of the earth.”
I in them and you in me, that they may become completely one, so that the world may know that you have sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.
points.apply: Show kindness this week to someone outside your usual circle.

concl: Unity is Jesus' own prayer and the Holy Spirit's gift.
A united Church makes Christ believable to the world.
2027-01-11.resolve: Before the Unity Octave begins, be reconciled with one person and pray daily for Christian unity.

intro: Theme: “Apart from me you can do nothing.”
One body and one vine: our life is in Christ and in one another.

q: I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Wonderful are your works; that I know very well.
For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, though many, are one body, so it is with Christ.
points.apply: Thank one person whose service in the parish goes unnoticed.

q: You brought a vine out of Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.
I am the vine, you are the branches. Those who abide in me and I in them bear much fruit, because apart from me you can do nothing.
points.apply: Begin each task this week with: Lord, apart from you I can do nothing.

q: the LORD appeared to him from far away. I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have continued my faithfulness to you.
As the Father has loved me, so I have loved you; abide in my love.
points.apply: Visit Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament once this week.

concl: Each of us is a needed member of Christ's Body.
Joined to the vine, we bear much fruit.
2027-01-12.resolve: Stay with Jesus for five minutes each day this week, and thank one fellow member of the parish.

intro: Theme: “For he is our peace.”
Christ gathers the far and the near into one household and entrusts it to shepherds who love him.

q: Peace, peace, to the far and the near, says the LORD; and I will heal them.
But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off have been brought near by the blood of Christ.
points.apply: Thank God this week for the gift of faith that reached our land.

q: For a child has been born for us, a son given to us; authority rests upon his shoulders; and he is named Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
For he is our peace; in his flesh he has made both groups into one and has broken down the dividing wall, that is, the hostility between us.
points.apply: Take down one wall: speak to someone you have kept at a distance.

q: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will make them lie down, says the Lord GOD.
A second time he said to him, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I love you.” Jesus said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
points.apply: Pray daily for the Pope, our Major Archbishop and your parish priest.

concl: In Christ no one is a stranger.
Love for the Shepherd becomes care for the flock.
2027-01-13.resolve: This week welcome one newcomer, and pray every day for our shepherds.

intro: Theme: “Why are you afraid? Have you still no faith?”
Christ in the storm, the care of God, and the steadfast faith of St Devasahayam.

sub: The Lord of wind and sea.
q: he made the storm be still, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
He woke up and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” Then the wind ceased, and there was a dead calm.
points.apply: Name one storm in your life and bring it to Jesus.

points.h: Cast all your anxiety on him
q: Cast your burden on the LORD, and he will sustain you; he will never permit the righteous to be moved.
Cast all your anxiety on him, because he cares for you.
points.apply: Each night this week hand one worry to the Lord.

q: therefore thus says the Lord GOD, See, I am laying in Zion a foundation stone, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation: “One who trusts will not panic.”
as it is written, “See, I am laying in Zion a stone that will make people stumble, a rock that will make them fall, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame.”
points.apply: Pray for persecuted Christians through the prayers of St Devasahayam.

concl: The Lord of wind and sea is in our boat.
St Devasahayam shows that faith can stand firm in the storm.
2027-01-14.resolve: Hand your anxieties to Jesus each night this week, and pray for those who suffer for their faith.

intro: Theme: “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
Peter and Paul: confession, life and weakness in the service of Christ.

points.h: Who do you say that I am?
q: I will tell of the decree of the LORD: He said to me, “You are my son; today I have begotten you.
He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Simon Peter answered, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
points.apply: Each morning this week make Peter's confession your own.

sub: The gates of Hades will not prevail.
q: I will place on his shoulder the key of the house of David; he shall open, and no one shall shut; he shall shut, and no one shall open.
And I tell you, you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
points.apply: Pray daily for the Pope and our bishops.

q: He gives power to the faint, and strengthens the powerless.
If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.
points.apply: Offer one weakness or suffering to Christ for the Church.

concl: Christ builds his Church on Peter's faith.
Through the apostles' weakness he gives life to the world.
2027-01-15.resolve: Confess Christ each morning and pray daily for the Pope this week.

intro: Theme: “So faith comes from what is heard.”
The Word who speaks with authority, and the messengers who carry it.

sub: A word that does what it says.
q: so shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and succeed in the thing for which I sent it.
They were astounded at his teaching, for he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
points.apply: Read the Gospel of the day each morning this week.

q: The spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me, because the LORD has anointed me; he has sent me to bring good news to the oppressed, to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and release to the prisoners;
But Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent, and come out of him!” And the unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
points.apply: Bring to confession whatever still binds you.

q: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of the messenger who announces peace, who brings good news, who announces salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns.”
And how are they to proclaim him unless they are sent? As it is written, “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!”
points.apply: Pray for and support a missionary this month.

concl: Jesus' word has authority to free and to heal.
Faith comes by hearing, and we are sent to speak.
2027-01-16.resolve: Tell one person this week, gently, what Jesus means to you.

intro: Theme: “Yet, O LORD, you are our Father.”
The fast of the Ninevites begins: prayer for mercy, prayer for all, mercy to one another.

q: Yet, O LORD, you are our Father; we are the clay, and you are our potter; we are all the work of your hand.
But we have this treasure in clay jars, so that it may be made clear that this extraordinary power belongs to God and does not come from us.
points.apply: Keep the three days' fast as fully as you can, as clay in God's hands.

sub: God desires all to be saved.
q: But seek the welfare of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray to the LORD on its behalf, for in its welfare you will find your welfare.
This is right and is acceptable in the sight of God our Savior, who desires everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
points.apply: Pray each day of the fast for our country and its leaders.

q: Forgive your neighbor the wrong he has done, and then your sins will be pardoned when you pray.
Should you not have had mercy on your fellow slave, as I had mercy on you?
points.apply: Forgive one person from your heart before the fast ends.

concl: The rogation of the Ninevites is a prayer for mercy for all.
We who ask mercy must give mercy.
2027-01-18.resolve: Make a good confession during the three days, and forgive before you confess.

intro: Theme: “God, be merciful to me, a sinner!”
The fast God accepts: a whole heart, walls taken down, a humble prayer.

q: If you are returning to the LORD with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Astartes from among you. Direct your heart to the LORD, and serve him only,
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
points.apply: Put away one idol during the fast.

q: See, the LORD’s hand is not too short to save, nor his ear too dull to hear. Rather, your iniquities have been barriers between you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you so that he does not hear.
Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your minds, so that you may discern what is the will of God
points.apply: Examine your conscience tonight and name the barriers.

q: The sacrifice acceptable to God is a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
I tell you, this man went down to his home justified rather than the other; for all who exalt themselves will be humbled, but all who humble themselves will be exalted.
points.apply: Pray the tax collector's prayer many times today.

concl: Fasting takes down the walls our sins have built.
The fast God accepts is humble and unites us with others.
2027-01-19.resolve: Do not speak of your fasting to anyone this week; speak only to God.

intro: Theme: “God changed his mind… and he did not do it.”
The fast of the Ninevites ends: a whole people turns, God has pity, and mercy is done in secret.

q: Blow the trumpet in Zion; sanctify a fast; call a solemn assembly; gather the people. Sanctify the congregation; assemble the aged; gather the children, even infants at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room, and the bride her canopy.
But when you give alms, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing, so that your alms may be done in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
points.apply: Give what you saved by fasting, in secret.

q: When God saw what they did, how they turned from their evil ways, God changed his mind about the calamity that he had said he would bring upon them; and he did not do it.
The people of Nineveh will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented at the proclamation of Jonah, and see, something greater than Jonah is here!
points.apply: Turn from one specific sin as the fast ends.

q: But I said, “I have labored in vain, I have spent my strength for nothing and vanity; yet surely my cause is with the LORD, and my reward with my God.”
“Everyone therefore who acknowledges me before others, I also will acknowledge before my Father in heaven;
points.apply: Do not hide your faith this week.

concl: God had pity on Nineveh, and he has pity on us.
End the fast with mercy in secret and faith without fear.
2027-01-20.resolve: Break the fast with an act of hidden charity for someone in need.

intro: Theme: “Joy in heaven over one sinner who repents.”
After the fast: the God who delights in mercy, and the joy of the found.

q: Say to them, As I live, says the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from their ways and live; turn back, turn back from your evil ways; for why will you die, O house of Israel?
The Lord is not slow about his promise, as some think of slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting any to perish, but all to come to repentance.
points.apply: Thank God for his patience with you.

q: He will again have compassion upon us; he will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea.

When he has found it, he lays it on his shoulders and rejoices. And when he comes home, he calls together his friends and neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep that was lost.’
points.apply: Do not dig up sins God has forgiven.

q: The LORD, your God, is in your midst, a warrior who gives victory; he will rejoice over you with gladness, he will renew you in his love; he will exult over you with loud singing
Just so, I tell you, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance.
points.apply: Reach out to one person who has drifted away.

concl: The fast ends in God's joy.
Let us rejoice, and seek the lost.
2027-01-21.resolve: Pray this week for one person far from God, by name.

intro: Theme: “In Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.”
The four Evangelists: God revealed, the Twelve sent, fathers in faith.

q: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces and said, “The LORD indeed is God; the LORD indeed is God.”
But these are written so that you may come to believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that through believing you may have life in his name.
points.apply: Thank God for the Gospels and those who brought them to Kerala.

q: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of the messenger who announces peace, who brings good news, who announces salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns.”
As you go, proclaim the good news, ‘The kingdom of heaven has come near.’ Cure the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out demons. You received without payment; give without payment.
points.apply: Share the Gospel freely with one person this week.

q: Your words were found, and I ate them, and your words became to me a joy and the delight of my heart; for I am called by your name, O LORD, God of hosts.
For though you might have ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers. Indeed, in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.
points.apply: Read one Gospel chapter every day.

concl: The Evangelists wrote what the apostles preached.
Through the Gospel they are our fathers in faith; we must pass it on.
2027-01-22.resolve: Read one Gospel chapter every day for the rest of January.

intro: Theme: “Woman, great is your faith!”
Worthy of the gospel, side by side, and a faith that does not give up.

points.h: Side by side for the gospel
sub: A life worthy of the gospel.
q: How very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
making every effort to maintain the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
points.apply: Pray this week with or for Christians of another Church.

q: these I will bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer; their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.
But she came and knelt before him, saying, “Lord, help me.”
points.apply: Bring one intention to Jesus every day this week.

q: The LORD is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Let it be done for you as you wish.” And her daughter was healed instantly.
points.apply: Do not stop praying when God seems silent.

concl: Christians are called to strive side by side for the one Gospel.
Humble, persistent faith is praised by Christ.
2027-01-23.resolve: Pray “Lord, help me” every day this week for one intention.

intro: Theme: “By the grace of God I am what I am.”
Two calls by name, and the generous wage of grace.

q: When the LORD saw that he had turned aside to see, God called to him out of the bush, “Moses, Moses!” And he said, “Here I am.”
He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
points.apply: Answer God today: Here I am.

q: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM.” He said further, “Thus you shall say to the Israelites, ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
He asked, “Who are you, Lord?” The reply came, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
points.apply: Treat the Church as the Body of Christ.

q: What shall I return to the LORD for all his bounty to me?
But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace toward me has not been in vain. On the contrary, I worked harder than any of them—though it was not I, but the grace of God that is with me.
points.apply: List three graces you did not earn.

q: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, nor are your ways my ways, says the LORD.
Am I not allowed to do what I choose with what belongs to me? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
points.apply: Rejoice in someone else's blessing.

concl: God calls by name and gives grace beyond merit.
Let gratitude replace envy, and unity replace division.
2027-01-25.resolve: Pray daily this week for Christian unity.

intro: Theme: “Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.”
The rest still open, the prophet rejected at home, and mercy beyond borders on Republic Day.

points.h: Today, if you hear his voice
q: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. O that today you would listen to his voice!
“Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.”
points.apply: Obey one word of today's Gospel before the day ends.

q: “Go now to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and live there; for I have commanded a widow there to feed you.”
And he said, “Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in the prophet's hometown.
points.apply: Listen with fresh ears to someone you know well.

sub: Fraternity in a land of many faiths.
q: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a reproach to any people.
Fight the good fight of the faith; take hold of the eternal life, to which you were called and for which you made the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.
points.apply: Pray for India and its leaders today.

concl: God's today is still open; do not harden your hearts.
Listen to the prophet at home and serve the nation with fraternity.
2027-01-26.resolve: Serve the common good in one concrete way this week.

intro: Theme: “He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.”
One Gospel, a servant who pleases God, and the Shepherd's voice.

q: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting the one who called you in the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel
points.apply: Read the Gospel of the day before any other message today.

q: The fear of others lays a snare, but one who trusts in the LORD is secure.
Am I now seeking human approval, or God's approval? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still pleasing people, I would not be a servant of Christ.
points.apply: Do one right thing today that no one will praise.

points.h: He calls his sheep by name
q: But now thus says the LORD, he who created you, O Jacob, he who formed you, O Israel: Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine.
When he has brought out all his own, he goes ahead of them, and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.
points.apply: Spend ten minutes listening to the Gospel in silence.

concl: There is one Gospel and one Shepherd.
Seek God's approval and follow the voice that calls you by name.
2027-01-27.resolve: Read a chapter of the Gospel each day this week.

intro: Theme: “For the love of Christ urges us on.”
The love that drives the apostle, the first disciples who came and saw, and St Thomas Aquinas.

q: One thing I asked of the LORD, that will I seek after: to live in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple.
When Jesus turned and saw them following, he said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which translated means Teacher), “where are you staying?”
points.apply: Answer Jesus' question honestly in prayer today.

q: O taste and see that the LORD is good; happy are those who take refuge in him.
He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they remained with him that day. It was about four o'clock in the afternoon.
points.apply: Invite one person to come and see Jesus with you.

points.h: The love of Christ urges us on
q: Therefore I prayed, and understanding was given me; I called on God, and the spirit of wisdom came to me.
For the love of Christ urges us on, because we are convinced that one has died for all; therefore all have died.
points.apply: Pray before study or work today for wisdom, as St Thomas did.

concl: Christ asks what we are looking for and invites us to come and see.
Let his love urge us on, until we want nothing but him.
2027-01-28.resolve: Bring one person closer to Christ this week.

intro: Theme: “The life of Jesus may also be made visible in our bodies.”
Innocent blood, the martyr's vision, and the glory hidden in affliction.

q: But Naboth said to Ahab, “The LORD forbid that I should give you my ancestral inheritance.”
so that upon you may come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Barachiah, whom you murdered between the sanctuary and the altar.
points.apply: Stand up for someone treated unjustly by the powerful.

sub: Lord, do not hold this sin against them.
q: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his faithful ones.
“Look,” he said, “I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
points.apply: Pray by name for someone who has wronged you.

q: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD rescues them from them all.
We are afflicted in every way, but not crushed; perplexed, but not driven to despair; persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed;
points.apply: Offer one affliction today, looking at what cannot be seen.

concl: The martyrs show Christ's face in suffering.
Look at what cannot be seen, and forgive.
2027-01-29.resolve: Pray each day this week for persecuted Christians.

intro: Theme: “Whoever is from God hears the words of God.”
Confident prayer, intercession for sinners, and the true children of Abraham.

q: The LORD is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
And this is the boldness we have in him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
points.apply: Pray today with confidence for one need, adding: your will be done.

q: And he believed the LORD; and the LORD reckoned it to him as righteousness.
Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham's children, you would be doing what Abraham did,
points.apply: Tell the truth today where a small lie would be easier.

q: Hear, O Israel: The LORD is our God, the LORD alone.
Whoever is from God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear them is that you are not from God.”
points.apply: Examine your conscience tonight and prepare for confession.

concl: We know the true God, and we can pray with confidence.
God's children listen to his words and pray for one another.
2027-01-30.resolve: Pray each day this week for someone who has fallen into sin.
